name: smwmusic-rhythm-heaven-remix
title: Rhythm Heaven - Remix 9
description:
The funky and all-over-the-place (as with most Rhythm Heaven music) music of the 9th Remix from Rhythm Heaven on the DS, prominently featuring the evil moais that nobody likes, but now with sunglasses!

Also my entry to 72hoSPC #6.

It's a song that's a bit chaotic. I suppose it could fit puzzles, bosses, or maybe even a rhythmic level.

On a more technical note, fitting the business of this song into 8 channels was Very messy and there's several instances of multiple of the original's channels/melodies being crammed into one SNES channel.
